provenance.statement: Users can reset their password by email.
Reset links must expire after 30 minutes and work only once.

assumptions: "Users" means registered account holders of an existing authentication system.
"By email" means a message is sent to the email address on the user's account.
The 30-minute expiry is measured from the time the reset link is issued.
"Work only once" means a link cannot be used again after a successful password reset.

ambiguities.question: What mechanism delivers the reset: a link with a token, a one-time code, or a temporary password?
ambiguities.resolution: A link, per the feedback: "Reset links must expire after 30 minutes and work only once."

ambiguities.question: How long is the reset credential valid, and is it single-use?
ambiguities.resolution: Valid for 30 minutes and usable only once, per the feedback.

ambiguities.question: What happens when the submitted email address matches no account (reveal or not reveal that fact)?
Are there rate limits or abuse protections on reset requests?
Must existing sessions be invalidated after a reset?
Are there password strength requirements for the new password?
Which email delivery provider or component sends the message?
Does an existing authentication or user-account component already exist that this extends?
Does requesting a new reset link invalidate earlier unused links?
Does a link that was never used count as consumed once it is opened, or only when a new password is successfully submitted?

acceptance_criteria.statement: A user can request a password reset by providing their email address.
A reset message containing a reset link is sent by email to the address on the user's account.
A user can set a new password by completing the reset flow delivered by email, after which the new password is usable to sign in.
A reset link expires 30 minutes after it is issued; using it after expiry does not reset the password.
A reset link works only once; a second use of the same link does not reset the password.

revision_history.summary: Incorporated feedback: links expire after 30 minutes and are single-use; resolved two ambiguities and added two.
